subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **either.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"either"** means one or the other of two people or things. (या तो)

 
 
• **Example: **You can either call me at home or at the office.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that citizens have the right to directly or through elected representatives participate in the decision-making process in a democratic society.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **either.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **however** (हालांकि): Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously.

 
 
• **Example:** She said she would be late; however, she arrived on time.
 
 
 
• **neither** (न तो): Not one nor the other of two people or things; not either.
 
 
• **Example:** Neither of the two options is suitable.
 
 
 
• **also** (भी): In addition; too.
 
 
• **Example:** She is not only a great singer but also a talented dancer.
